description: This list catalogues Japanese GTFS, GTFS-JP and GTFS Realtime data published as open data, with each feed's publisher and validity date. A notice states that updates have been paused since March 2024 with no restart date. The page warns that it does not guarantee data quality: some feeds have expired end dates or only lack updated dates, some place stops at a single wrong point such as the middle of a road, and some keep old timetables or miss new routes, so users of routing, commercial or research applications should check feeds and, if possible, tell the publisher. Coverage: Japan. Format and access: a web table of links. Licence and cost: free; licences follow each feed. Caveats: frozen since 2024 and in Japanese. It supports network flow models by pointing to feeds, with its quality warnings useful for data cleaning. It relates to the GTFS-JP standard and the Mobility Database in the catalogue.
